policy.manual_review: A hash identifies the exact reviewed input; it cannot judge anatomy, emotion, chronology, apparent height or artistic quality. Only explicit review with notes/evidence can pass a manual row.
policy.invalidation: Changed files, newly matched input files, acceptance criteria, evidence or check tooling invalidate previous receipts. Unresolved dependency checks block a pass.
policy.limits: LIMITED is visibly unverified and never counted as PASS. Only declared optional platform/device limits may use it; required failures cannot be waived.
policy.build_phases: Content evidence is reviewed before final packaging. Native/runtime and post-build browser/archive/movie evidence are separate to avoid requiring a package to exist before building it.
policy.storage: One latest receipt per check. Game assets/exports are replaced in place; no before/after bundles are shipped.
policy.image_quality: Every selected image has an independent quality row. Choose a suitable prior reference explicitly; compare composition, lighting, detail, anatomy, identity, sharpness and edit regression. Author rejection remains a failure until corrected and freshly reviewed.

scenes.title: First memory
scenes.story_requirement: First Breath is told to Cali by her parents. Newborn illustration gives way to later household life before Lyra's arrival and the three-child family are described. Constellation means the five adults' partnership.

scenes.title: A small beginning
scenes.story_requirement: Maia and Cali plant the source's sunflower. The watering mishap and marker stone are modest connective details; the unfamiliar ladder is a place Cali has yet to climb.

scenes.title: Room for both
scenes.story_requirement: Flower placement is a practical disagreement about appearance and light. Pots and the kneeling illustration belong on dry ground beside the pond.

scenes.title: The scattered pieces
scenes.story_requirement: Arin uses they/them; the source's spilled screws lead to sorting and reassurance. The small trays do not introduce new world mechanics.

scenes.title: A color you can hear
scenes.story_requirement: A broken single note precedes the multi-note attempt. Flute up/rest illustrations follow the action. Selene's association of music with pale blue is in the source, and is expressed as an association.

scenes.title: Routes through a story
scenes.story_requirement: Dorian tells historical exploration stories. His advice about carrying history is from the source, not a literal claim of an unseen companion.

scenes.title: Three ways forward
scenes.story_requirement: Sage's three siblings are explicitly fictional. Their failed search, mineral blockage, adapted filter, and cooperation follow the source.

scenes.title: The days between
scenes.story_requirement: The narrator explicitly distinguishes many mornings/evenings from a single day. Later flute practice follows the initial lesson. Sage's fictional mouse named Nibble is also in the prose; the actual familiar remains a rat.

scenes.title: The Tree of Echoes
scenes.story_requirement: The ancient transplanted tree is distinct from the garden's treehouse oak. Its near-voices are explicitly wood creaking. Lumen is identified as a living ship here.

scenes.title: The shallow water
scenes.story_requirement: Lyra panics after slipping into a shallow pond. Cali and Kael help her out; wet recovery follows the rescue illustration. No deep-water incident is added.

scenes.title: A little too much
scenes.story_requirement: Lyra's strong spice, embarrassment, Maia's reassurance, and their second pot retain the source's progression.

scenes.title: Wishes in the light
scenes.story_requirement: The community fills the central plaza. Selene performs, Maia's flowers are displayed, and the children release lanterns and make their source wishes.

scenes.title: An invitation
scenes.story_requirement: Cassia draws Cali into her fictional creature story. Its imagined purple-and-gold eyes describe the creature, not either girl's design.

scenes.title: Room for another story
scenes.story_requirement: Thalia listens and mediates; Lyron discusses shared water systems on a later evening. Their professions and relationship to Cassia match the source.

scenes.title: Something worth finding
scenes.story_requirement: Joren leads children through the construction zone and issues the source's challenge. Cali responds eagerly. The invented blue-light meeting is absent.

scenes.title: Things we could make
scenes.story_requirement: Soren guides Cali's small rover project. Their workshop discussion stays within the source's invention and exploration interests.

scenes.title: Beyond the familiar paths
scenes.story_requirement: Kaleb leads a walk through unfamiliar passages. The map at Cali's home then connects visits with both friends to their growing use of the treehouse.

scenes.title: Our place in the branches
scenes.story_requirement: The treehouse already holds shared possessions and memories. Joren's promise to keep meeting there is established before the loss.

scenes.title: A story under the rain
scenes.story_requirement: Cassia asks the source's hypothetical question about talking trees. The group is telling a story under blankets, not receiving a supernatural message.

scenes.title: Something that turns
scenes.story_requirement: The source's “as we grew older” introduces later childhood, not Book II's late teens. The miniature waterwheel moves from workshop to pond.

scenes.title: The unfinished world
scenes.story_requirement: The portable scanner, construction machinery, and projected blueprint are source material. Joren's light here is an ordinary light during the later expedition.

scenes.title: A place beside us
scenes.story_requirement: Lyra's earlier occasional participation is distinguished from wanting to be included more often. Her invitation does not pretend she has never accompanied them.

scenes.title: The view from above
scenes.story_requirement: The unfinished dome, careful climb, long afternoon, and return follow the source. This is a happy childhood expedition, not the cause of Joren's death.

scenes.title: Which way we go
scenes.story_requirement: Both friends contribute to the argument. Cassia and the familiars help them compromise. The source's closing reflections bridge these ordinary days to the next scene.

scenes.title: The news
scenes.story_requirement: The routine family research expedition to a nearby moon precedes an unspecified malfunction and failed rescue. The source's cultural shock, mortality reflection, shared grief, Lyra's confusion, and empty treehouse remain in order.

scenes.title: What comfort can do
scenes.story_requirement: Maia's words about Joren living in their stories and memories are source language. Her embrace accompanies Cali's grief; it supplies no literal return or quick cure.

scenes.title: What the hand remembers
scenes.story_requirement: Painting and the familiars' company give Cali small things to do. No later adventure or resolution of grief is invented.

scenes.title: Between the two of us
scenes.story_requirement: Cassia's question and shared grief follow the prose. The remembered dome is an event the reader has already seen. The seated hand-holding illustration supports their comfort.

scenes.title: The names we carry
scenes.story_requirement: The same central plaza becomes a memorial. Soren's work and Kaleb's source address remain part of community mourning; no additional casualty is asserted.

scenes.title: A place to remember
scenes.story_requirement: The mural belongs in Maia's garden. Cassia helps remember their shared adventures.

scenes.title: The rain returns
scenes.story_requirement: New drawings and messages join the old maps. Rain accompanies remembering and drawing together.

scenes.title: What remains
scenes.story_requirement: Annual gatherings are retrospective, without assigning new ages to unchanged child sprites. The book ends with Joren's enduring absence.
